title: Buzz Aldrin's Masonic lodge on the Moon

tellings.quote: Buzz aldron even established a masonic lodge on the Moon called Tranquility Lodge 2000 chartered by the Grand Lodge of Texas
and you had launchpad 33 for NASA and then you also had Buzz Aldrin who was a Freemason literally stake out the moon if you know that with a with a a Freemasonic flag or whatever.
tellings.difference: Speaks of a Masonic flag rather than a chartered lodge, and adds NASA's launch pad 33.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Buzz Aldrin staking a Masonic claim on the Moon.

as_told.title: Launch pad 33 and Buzz Aldrin's Masonic flag on the Moon

tellings.quote: According to the Masonic Grand Lodge of Ohio, the Apollo 11 mission even established an appendant body of the Masonic Lodge on the moon.
tellings.difference: Gives the Masonic Grand Lodge of Ohio as its source and mentions a Scottish Rite flag and the Washington Masonic Temple, where the story names a charter from the Grand Lodge of Texas.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Aldrin establishing a Masonic lodge or body on the Moon and planting a Masonic flag.

as_told.title: Scottish Rite flag and a Masonic lodge body on the moon

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Buzz Aldrin, the astronaut who walked on the Moon, was a Freemason, a member of an old fraternal society, and set up a Masonic lodge on the Moon called Tranquility Lodge 2000, chartered by the Grand Lodge of Texas. In another telling he speaks of Aldrin staking out the Moon with a Masonic flag, and also points to NASA's launch pad 33. Michels tells it because, if true, it would hint at secret societies quietly shaping the space program.
